aestheticBenchmark.target: Semi-realistic/realistic rendered fantasy strategy art as demonstrated in landscape mocks M01–M30.
aestheticBenchmark.palette: 60/30/10 Slate, Stone, and Burnished Gold UI chrome with realistic natural environmental materials (wood, stone, leather, iron, cloth).
aestheticBenchmark.spatialGrid: 8px rhythm with 4px fine accents; 16/20/25/31 CSS-pixel typography.
aestheticBenchmark.lighting: Coherent upper-left warm daylight with realistic ground contact shadows and perspective depth.
